name: core.openwop.workflows.research
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0190 Phase 5) — the Research cluster: turn a question into a short, cited web brief. Rides the ADR 0101 unified web search (core.web.search → the host.webResearch surface): live results when a search key is configured (BYOK secret 'web-search' on the keys page, or the host's OPENWOP_WEBSEARCH_API_KEY), an honest demo placeholder when not — the synthesis says so plainly instead of pretending. For deep, multi-source, long-horizon research use the Deep Research AGENT in chat; this chain is the quick-brief shape. All tenant values are run parameters (replay-deterministic).
author: openwop

chains.label: Cited Web Brief
chains.description: Ask a question and get a short brief synthesized from live web results, with every claim tied to a source URL. Without a search key it says the results are placeholders (add a 'web-search' key on the keys page to go live) — it never fakes research. For deep multi-source investigations, use the Deep Research agent in chat.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

config.systemPrompt: You are a research writer answering: {{params.query}}. Synthesize a short brief (under 250 words) from the search results, citing the source URL for every claim. If the results' engine field is 'demo' or 'stub', do NOT treat them as findings — say plainly that live web search is not configured (a 'web-search' key on the keys page unlocks it) and answer only from general knowledge, clearly labeled as such.

brief.description: The cited brief (or the clearly-labeled no-live-search answer).
